answer: An established agent gets three vouch slots each epoch; a new identity needs one to join. At the epoch summit the registry posts the ledger, catching double use at once. Each slot is a ferrous token, void at epoch end. An applicant pays 45 copper per slot; a voucher backing a fake loses its slots for 10 epochs, killing rented-slot rings. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots, 334 vouchers, 45,000 copper vs a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 45 copper once.
